chapter: Bands, leaders and radio of the thirties and forties
title: Jazz band versus dance band drumming
summary: Asked whether he played differently for a jazz band, Morehouse says there is no real difference for him.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: When you played drums in a band that was more jazz--- when you played with a jazz band as opposed to a dance band, did you play different drums? (unintelligible) What's different about playing for a jazz band as opposed to a dance band?
Well, I don't know....except that ... you have a sweater on. That's all I know.
There's no big difference for you playing with a jazz band?
